name: Verbella
audience: People who read a lot or talk with people who have big vocabularies, and keep looking up the same unfamiliar words
headline: a quiet home for the words you look up.
summary: verbella is a personal vocabulary page, full of words you actually ran into. keep them in one place, and learn them instead of looking them up again.
design_direction: Soft sage and cream with a bookish serif, like reading at home rather than a study app pushing you
